additional_info.subject: RE: 0436204-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / S6 170003805]  Issue in plug CRM:02888000132
additional_info.body:
Hello Monica,
Hope you are doing great.
Following the issue reported by the end customer regarding DC1 not functioning properly, we have investigated and identified a temperature sensor error associated with Plug 1. Our findings confirm that DC1 is affected.
Could you please confirm whether a hard reboot of the charger was performed to address this issue?
Additionally, we request you to measure and share the voltage between the Control Pilot (CP) and ground. Kindly let us know if the voltage deviates from the expected constant 12V.
Based on our analysis, these errors appear to be caused by ambient temperatures exceeding the charger's operating range.
If above condition is normal, then we will recommend you the following steps to be followed-
1. Check resistance between P1 and P2, N1 and N2 in below attached image, and check at the XD10.
2. Connectivity between P2 & N2.
3. Interchange the wiring of DC1 & DC2 cable to check from where the issue is generating.
Temp Vs Resistance Table-->
If it is possible please carry a resistor along with you as per temp mentioned in above table so that we can check the KF13 also.

Dear Davy,
My apologies for not getting back to you earlier.
You message is well received. This we also stated to Wim during our weekly updates calls with Sparki and EPDC. We are aiming to get this resolved asap.
There is some confusion between Siemens Belgium (the official entity that needs to pay the invoices) and Heliox (the entity executing this service). After discussing this internally, we have defined how to clear this out and get the invoices paid. For this, a PO needs to be created to you coming from Siemens Belgium.
